verdict: The NautilusTrader Rust crates (v0.67.0) CAN run the backtest engine without Python. All infrastructure types exist: BacktestEngine, BacktestEngineConfig, SimulatedVenueConfig, Equity, Bar, Strategy trait, InstrumentAny, BacktestResult.
evidence_source: modules/trading/_rust/nautilus-probe/src/main.rs, which builds, links and runs against the published crates

crate_version_mismatch.impact: None. The Rust crates are the underlying engine that the Python bindings wrap. Version 0.67.0 is the latest published Rust SDK (2026-11-07). The Python 1.231.0 wheel bundles these same crates under pyo3. The crate versions are independent of the Python release version.

what_works_in_pure_rust: SimulatedVenueConfig with Cash or Margin accounts
Any instrument type: CurrencyPair, BinaryOption, OptionContract, FuturesContract, etc.
Strategy trait and the nautilus_strategy! macro for custom strategies
The EmaCross example strategy (under `examples` feature flag)
BacktestEngine run lifecycle (start, data processing, iterations, dispose)
BacktestResult with fills, positions, PnL, returns series
Canonical result with deterministic fills projection
Feature-gated compilation (no pyo3, no python feature needed)

what_needs_porting_from_python.item: weather-rules strategy logic (event contract pricing, question parsing)
what_needs_porting_from_python.rust_crate_availability: BinaryOption and OptionContract instrument types exist in nautilus-model v0.67.0
what_needs_porting_from_python.gap: The rule engine itself (probability, edge, question parsing) is written in Python, not Rust

what_needs_porting_from_python.rust_crate_availability: OptionGreeks data type, OptionContract instrument exist in nautilus-model
what_needs_porting_from_python.gap: The proposal logic (admissible, sizing, chain walking) is written in Python

what_needs_porting_from_python.rust_crate_availability: No NautilusTrader adapter exists for Public; would need to use Public's API crate or custom HTTP client
what_needs_porting_from_python.gap: Public's personal-secret-based API signing is Python-only (requests library)

bottom_line: Yes, the weather and equity strategies CAN run on the Rust crates alone, once their logic is ported from Python to Rust. The engine infrastructure is fully available. The existing weather-backtest Rust crate (modules/trading/_rust/weather-backtest/) already shows the weather rules being ported.
